what: Step 2b.5 adds a new numbered sub-step but the plan never updates the Step Name Registry or the Anti-halt sub-step chain that still lists 2a.5 to 2b to 3 only.
scenario_or_breakage: skills/shared/progress-reporting.md requires each orchestrator step number to map through the registry for breadcrumb short names; omitting 2b.5 makes the new sub-step name non-normative and invites inconsistent operator-visible breadcrumbs.
suggested_fix: Add a `2b.5` row to step-name-registry.tsv and extend the Anti-halt continuation line in SKILL.md so `2b.5` appears between `2b` and `3` (and any other explicit `2b to 3` jump text updated accordingly).

what: The harness spec claims lexicographic `TRIGGER_REASONS` ordering but the worked example order is not lexicographic.
scenario_or_breakage: Implementors or reviewers will sort tokens differently than the harness expects causing false failures or wrong comma ordering.
suggested_fix: Either change the example to true lexicographic order (`diff-lines,files-count,plan-body-lines`) or drop the lexicographic requirement and document deterministic ordering explicitly.

what: The plan tells the orchestrator to parse KV lines from ordinary stdout after sourcing `lib-quiet.sh` with `larch_quiet_init`.
scenario_or_breakage: Under the quiet-by-default contract ordinary `printf` / `echo` to stdout is redirected to the quiet log; only `emit` / `emit_kv` reach FD 3; naive stdout KV would make Step 2b.5 see empty captures and mis-fire branches.
suggested_fix: Specify in check-plan-size.md and the helper that machine-readable keys use `emit_kv` (mirroring emit-plan.sh) and describe how the orchestrator should capture that contract stream.

what: The Split-path preservation note leans on `PLAN_WRITE_OK` gating Step 6 cleanup.
scenario_or_breakage: On the Split / hard-fail path execution typically terminates before Step 5 and Step 6 anyway; tying preservation primarily to `PLAN_WRITE_OK` is easy to misread as a Step 6 invariant when the real reason is early abort before cleanup.
suggested_fix: Reword to state that Split exits before finalize/cleanup while still noting `PLAN_WRITE_OK` remains unset for consistency with other bail paths.

what: Gate A re-fire bullet cites `discussion-rounds.md` without the `references/` prefix.
scenario_or_breakage: Implementors may open a non-existent top-level path under skills/design.
suggested_fix: Use the repo-relative path `skills/design/references/discussion-rounds.md` in the plan text and SKILL insertion.

what: Case 11 promises boundary verification for all three numeric thresholds but only spells out `diff_lines` 600 vs 601 examples.
scenario_or_breakage: `plan_lines` 250 vs 251 and `files-count` 8 vs 9 edge cases may ship without harness coverage despite being called out in Edge cases.
suggested_fix: Add explicit harness cases (or extend case 11) for plan-body line and files-count `==` vs `>` boundaries matching the Edge cases section.
